task.question: What position did Dharmendra Pradhan resign from in India in July 2026?
task.evidence: July 25 – Indian Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigns from the position in light of the protests over a NEET exam leak. Most of the protests ceased following his resignation.

answer: Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his position as the Union Education Minister of India on July 25, 2026, amid widespread protests concerning irregularities in the NEET examination. FINAL: Union Education Minister.
